title: ci(spec-main-shape-gate): drop the merge_group trigger now the context is out of the required set (objectui#12252)
body:
Fixes #12252

Drops the `merge_group` trigger from `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` now that `Spec Main Shape Gate` is no longer a required context. The ruling is the maintainer's answer B on objectui#12240 (ACCEPT 6125070195); this is the one-trigger follow-up it left open, sequenced after the ruleset edit and after PR #12250 merged.

## What changed

- `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`: `merge_group` leaves `on:`. `pull_request` (the advisory signal a human reads), the hourly `schedule` on `main` (`48 * * * *`) and `workflow_dispatch` stay. The comments that reasoned about queue builds follow: the header's bullet on `merge_group`, the `concurrency` comment, the `timeout-minutes` comment, and the one header sentence that listed a queue build beside a pull request as a run of its own branch's YAML.
- `scripts/__tests__/spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts`: the pin "subscribes merge_group, so a maintainer can enrol it without stalling the queue" becomes its inverse, "does not subscribe merge_group - re-subscribe merge_group before re-enrolling the context". Same one-line comment fix as the workflow on the artifact-trust assertion.
- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: only the sentences that said the gate runs on the queue: the inventory row's trigger cell, the section's trigger line, the artifact-trust sentence, the sentence naming what the test file pins, and the last bullet of "How it became a required check, and how it left the set".

Nothing the gate verifies changes. Not touched: the gate's steps, the anti-false-green marker, the schedule, the seven-name pin in `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`, `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, `ci.yml`, `AGENTS.md`, the queue guard. No overlap with the in-flight PRs on `ci.yml` and `turbo.json` (objectui#12222) or on `AGENTS.md` and the queue guard (objectui#12255); `origin/main` was merged at `10aba37d` before this PR was opened and none of its files touch this surface.

## The precondition, read live before the first commit

Ruleset 11776024, read at 2026-10-12T14:19:18Z with `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rulesets/11776024 --jq '[.rules[] | select(.type=="required_status_checks") | .parameters.required_status_checks[].context]'`:

```
["Lint","Type Check","Build & E2E","Build Docs","Changeset Declaration","Test","Governed Surface Queue Guard"]
```

Seven names; `Spec Main Shape Gate` is not listed, so dropping the trigger cannot stall a queue build. `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` run bare could not take its own reading from this container (HTTP 401 through the agent proxy, exit 2, which the script says is not a pass). The same script fed the live `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` answer through `--fixture` read: `INTACT - 1 pinned and 6 watched context(s) all present (7 required context(s) read)`, exit 0.

## Verification (head `17033fd1`)

- The six test files that read this workflow or its enumerations (`spec-main-shape-gate`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `check-required-check-set`, `dependabot-merge-gate`, `check-merge-queue-head`): 6 files, 252 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0` under the verify lock. The count equals the pre-change count, since one pin was rewritten in place.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --listFilesOnly` lists the edited test file.
- Workflow YAML parse: base had four triggers (`merge_group`, `pull_request`, `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch`), head has three (`pull_request`, `schedule`, `workflow_dispatch`); the parsed file minus `on:` (jobs, permissions, concurrency, name) is identical to base's; the cron and the `pull_request` branches are unchanged.
- `check-doc-links`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-action-ref-convention`: exit 0 each. Control-byte `grep -P` over the three edited files: no match. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the three paths: NOT GOVERNED. `check-changeset-presence`: no changeset owed (no released package source moved). Targeted eslint over the edited test file: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- NOT MEASURED: repo-wide `pnpm lint` (CI owns it; the targeted run above is the only local reading) and `actionlint` (not installed; the YAML parse above stands in).

## Ablation (each leg committed first, run through the ablation tool: anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; no build or dist involved, root scripts)

- A. The name back in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` without the trigger: `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` 1 failed, 17 passed. The failing assertion is "the merge_group floor derives itself from REQUIRED_CONTEXTS (#6160) > requires merge_group of every workflow that produces a required context": `These workflows produce a context REQUIRED_CONTEXTS declares blocking, but do not subscribe merge_group: - spec-main-shape-gate.yml (produces Spec Main Shape Gate)`, expected [ 'spec-main-shape-gate.yml' ] to deeply equal []. Direction observed: red, as predicted. The derived floor refuses the half-restored state on its own.
- B. The trigger restored, name still not required: `spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts` 1 failed, 35 passed; the new pin reds with its message, expected true to be false.
- C. Control, both restored: the floor passes (`merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` passed) and only the new pin reds (1 failed, 53 passed over the two files). So A's red is attributable to the missing trigger and nothing else.

## NOT MEASURED, owed after landing

The card's last acceptance item, "three merge groups after landing carry no Spec Main Shape Gate check run", can only be read once this lands. It is the seat's reading, not a local one. On this PR itself, `Spec Main Shape Gate` keeps `pull_request` and should still post its verdict here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- 改了什么:`Spec Main Shape Gate` 这条 workflow 不再订阅合并队列(`merge_group`),只保留 PR 上的提示性运行、`main` 上每小时一次的完整运行和手动触发。同时改了对应的测试钉子和 CI 文档里「在队列上运行」的几句话。
- 为什么改:该检查已不在 ruleset 的必需名单里(上面读的是七个名字,没有它),队列上跑出来的结果没有人看,却每个合并组都占一台 runner。这是 objectui#12240 裁决 B 留下的后续一步,顺序是先合并、再改 ruleset、最后才去掉触发。
- 风险与代价(含回滚):风险很小,检查本身验证的内容一个字没动,PR 上仍然会报。唯一的坑是将来如果要把它重新设为必需检查,必须先把 `merge_group` 订阅回来再改 ruleset,否则队列会卡在 60 分钟超时;测试钉子和 `merge-queue-reporting` 的派生下限都会在顺序错了时变红提醒。回滚就是把 `merge_group` 那两行加回 `on:`,并把测试里的钉子翻回去。
- 席位意见:
- 你要做的:本 PR 是 draft,按 `.github/workflows/**` 的约定等你批准后再由席位入队。合并后请席位读三个合并组,确认其中没有 `Spec Main Shape Gate` 的检查运行。
